name: Tokumaru Iechika
source:
A Japanese noble.
He's in charge of managing his family's land and assets.
A polite and calm man who has an interest in Japanese poetry and bushido and likes to collect classic cars.
In his second year of university he studied overseas in England and met Ashe.
